THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Revocation of Order under Section 4(1)

WHEREAS by Order made under Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments ofCeylon (Revised Edition 1956 ), as amended by Acts Nos. 14 and 62 of 1957, 14 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 read with IndustrialDisputes (Special Provisions) Act No. 37 of 1968 dated 16.08.2016 and published in the Gazette of the Democratic SocialistRepublic of Sri Lanka Extraordinary No. 1981/21 dated 22.08.2016 the Industrial Dispute in respect of the matter specified in thestatement of the Commissioner of Labour dated 25.07.2016.
Mr. D. G. Wijeratne, No. 187/2, Thotupolawatte, Alawatugoda.
and
University Grants Commission, No. 20, Ward Place, Colombo 07.
was referred to Mr. P. Nawaratne for settlement by arbitration.

AND whereas it is now deemed expedient that the said Order by revoked, I, Ravindra Samaraweera, Minister of Labour andTrade Union Relations do hereby revoke the said Order and further make Order that no proceedings be taken upon the saidOrder dated 16.08.2016.
RAVINDRA SAMARAWEERA,Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.
29th August, 2018.Colombo.10 – 13/1

and
University Grants Commission, No. 20, Ward Place, Colombo 07.

NOW THEREFORE I, Ravindra Samaraweera, Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations do by virtue of the powers vestedin me by Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 RevisedEdition), as amended by Acts Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial disputes-Special Provisions) ActNo. 37 of 1968 hereby appoint Mr. L. and
University Grants Commission, No. 20, Ward Place, Colombo 07.
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether the demand made by Mr. D. G. Wijeratne who held the post of Staff Assistant (Book-Keeper) of the University ofPeradeniya that the promotion to the post of Assistant Internal Officer which was granted to him by the University GrantsCommission should be back dated 05.02.2008 and the said post be designated as the Assistant Bursar and be paid arrears ofsalary and other allowances accordingly is justified and to what relief he is entitled.

Dated at the office of the Commissioner of Labour,Colombo, this 16th day of August 2018.
